mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
